## Session 1 — 12:19

**Intent:** Rework the `/my-status` skill so the status posted to the team is today's plan only (per team feedback: no backlog)
**Tags:** #tooling #chat_connector #feedback #config
**Files touched:**
- M .claude/skills/my-status/SKILL.md

**Nodes referenced:** [[feedback_status_ticket_reference]], [[feedback_teams_messages_english]], [[user_identity]], [[feedback_session_close]]
**Nodes created:** [[feedback_status_today_only]]
**State changes:** added [30] (PR #1 my-status rework awaiting review/merge)

### Done
- Reworked **send** mode: take all open tasks ordered by `sequence`, estimate each, propose the set that fits about 6 focused hours a day as "Planned for today" (estimate + link per task). The backlog is shown to the user during the draft for confirm or swap only — never posted.
- Dropped from the posted message: the backlog "Next up" section, the user's name (it is sent from their own account), and the "estimate" label.
- Created the node [[feedback_status_today_only]] and its index pointer.
- Parent repo: committed on branch `chore/my-status-today-plan` (a13ac3f), pushed, opened PR #1 (base `main`).

### Decisions
- Detection method chosen by the user: list all assigned tasks by `sequence`, let Claude estimate and propose the day's closeable set, and also show the backlog so a task can be swapped (re-estimated on swap), confirm → send. The human-in-the-loop draft absorbs any detection error, so no rigid "planned today" field is needed.

- Categorized cash flow design (a director's ask). Discovery: the production chart of accounts is only partly visible to the service account; the custom account type taxonomy in the accounting module already buckets P&L. Confirmed the lead-time sources: component = `product.supplierinfo.delay` (the BOM report's "Leadtime" column), manufacturing = `product.template.produce_delay` (a ready-made field, mrp/models/product.py:33).
- Locked: per company (a single-company wizard, no consolidation); START with Cash In + Cash Out (COGS); a supply-chain timing model; a) the supplier purchase price, b) net free stock, c) pay-then-manufacture (switchable), d) split payment terms (50/50) through the existing anchor and installment helpers. ### Decisions
- Chat always English and ticket-by-KIO-key codified in the skills and in memory.
- COGS = BOM-exploded supply-chain timing (component lead time + supplier term → Cash Out; + produce_delay + customer term → Cash In), NOT a simple dated-at-commitment model.
- No new production ticket created — this is KIO-1002 scope; the spec lives in a repo file as the next-session handoff (the session was near its context limit, so the user starts fresh to implement).
